categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Labeled 'macOS' and fixes an OS-specific socket runtime failure where macOS select() returns EINVAL on large timeouts.
categories.rationale: Fixes a supported-platform failure on macOS where bitcoin-cli fails immediately when run with -rpcclienttimeout=0. Per the PR description, this is a regression since #34342 present in v32.0rc1/rc2.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Utils/log/libs' and updates Sock::WaitMany timeout handling in src/util/sock.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents socket wait failures caused by integer overflow or system limit violations in select() and poll(). As noted in commit 8dcf90a9b3, systems using select() fail with EINVAL when timeout durations exceed 10^8 seconds.
